body:
ACS Detailing Ltd, located at 20 Shaw Road, Newhey, Rochdale, has been placed into liquidation, according to an official notice published in The Gazette on 11 November 2026.

The company, which specialised in engineering design activities for industrial processes and production, has appointed Ian James Royle and David Adam Broadbent of BTG Begbies Traynor (Central) LLP as liquidators.

The decision to liquidate was made by the members and creditors of the company, although specific details regarding the reasons for the liquidation have not been disclosed.

This development may impact employees and clients of ACS Detailing Ltd, as the company ceases operations and the liquidators manage the winding down of its affairs.

corrections.note: Updated on 12 November 2026 with later information from The Gazette.
